name: Firecrawl
description: Firecrawl is a hosted web scraping, crawling, search and extraction API for AI agents.
auth_notes: API key sent as Authorization: Bearer fc-... on https://api.firecrawl.dev; some endpoints work keyless with limits. OAuth for apps lets users connect their own accounts.
gate_detail: Key is found in the Firecrawl dashboard; a Free plan exists with lower limits, and paid plans (Hobby to Scale) raise credits and concurrency. Keyless access to some endpoints with limits.
api_scope: Endpoints for scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, agent, interact browser sessions and Alexandria under api.firecrawl.dev; Python and Node SDK examples shown.
mcp_notes: Vendor docs document a hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in, API-key bearer, or keyless access.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment needed to start; heavier usage needs paid credits and higher rate limits.

evidence.quote: Requests need an Authorization header with your API key, except on the keyless endpoints described below:
You can find your API key in the Firecrawl dashboard
A few endpoints, including /v2/scrape , /v2/search and /v2/parse , also work without a key, with limits.
API-key connections use https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp with a bearer token instead
To let users connect their own Firecrawl account to your app instead, use OAuth for apps .

issues: Free signup steps and free-plan credit amount are not stated in the sources.
No dedicated API test sandbox is described.
Webhook support is inferred only from a docs tag named Webhook Payloads.

searches.query: Firecrawl API credentials pricing plan required developer access
